mentions.name: TrailTool
mentions.description: This tool aggregates AWS CloudTrail logs for analysis in both a UI and AI contexts, tying logs together into meaningful narratives for security investigations and role engineering (reducing privileges on human-operated IAM roles). It exposes the data via MCP for agent workflows with high quality, low latency, and manageable context size, and can be tried by deploying a CloudFormation stack to a sandbox AWS account.
mentions.problem: It is tough to tie together CloudTrail logs into meaningful narratives useful not only for security investigations but also role engineering (reducing privileges on human-operated IAM roles).
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on TrailTool, which aggregates CloudTrail for analysis in both UI and AI contexts.
